settings.title: Settings
settings.fontPreview: Our Father, who art in heaven
settings.engineHint: Automatic uses the browser’s own recognition (Web Speech) and switches to offline Whisper where there is none (e.g. Firefox).
settings.whisperIntro: Recognises speech right on this device: 100% private — the audio never leaves it — and it works in Firefox too. It is slower than the browser’s recognition, especially on older phones, and checks each sentence after you finish it (no live listening).
settings.whisperModelHint: Base (recommended) recognises Polish much better; Tiny is smaller and faster but makes more mistakes.
settings.whisperUnavailable: This browser can’t run Whisper (it needs Web Workers, WebAssembly, offline storage and microphone recording).
settings.whisperNeedsDownload: Download the model to use Whisper.
settings.whisperDone: Whisper is ready — it works offline now
settings.whisperFailed: The download failed. Check your connection and try again.
settings.whisperNoSpace: There isn’t enough storage space on this device for the model.
settings.whisperConfirmBody: Teleo will download about {{size}} once: the model from Hugging Face (huggingface.co) and the speech engine from Teleo’s site. On mobile data this can be costly — use Wi-Fi if you can. Afterwards recognition works offline and your audio never leaves the device.
settings.strictHint: Strict: every word counts, a different word is rejected. Gentle: a different word counts only as missing — helpful when recognition often mishears you.
settings.handsFreeHint: Keep listening through the whole session and check each sentence as you speak.
settings.saveTranscriptsHint: Store what was recognised with each attempt. When off, only the result is kept. Audio is never stored.
settings.dayStartHint: Praying after midnight still counts for the previous day until this hour.
settings.focus: What do you want to practise?
settings.focusHint: Shows or hides the builtin texts and sessions and pins a matching session.
settings.formHint: Builtin Polish affirmations use this grammatical form (e.g. “spokojny” / “spokojna”).
settings.reminderHint: Teleo has no server to send notifications, so the reminder lives in your phone’s calendar — reliable and free.
settings.reminderBody: Say your prayers and affirmations aloud.
settings.backupHint: All data lives only on this device. Export a copy regularly and keep it safe.
settings.importBody: Everything on this device will be replaced by the backup from {{date}}. This can’t be undone.
settings.privacyHint: No account, no server, no tracking. Your texts and history stay in this browser.
settings.persistedOn: on — the browser won’t clear Teleo’s data on its own
settings.persistedOff: off — the browser may clear data when space is low
settings.deleteBody: Texts, sessions, history, achievements and settings will be removed from this device. Type {{word}} to confirm.
settings.about: Teleo {{version}} — free and open, runs entirely in your browser.

result.acceptedNear: Accepted — a few words sounded slightly different.
result.empty: I didn’t hear anything. Try again a little louder.

speech.howWeCountBody: A sentence counts when at least 95% of its words were said and you added no extra words. For sentences shorter than 20 words this means every word — one skipped word is tolerated only from 20 words up. Small recognition slips (missing Polish letters, one wrong letter in a longer word) are forgiven; filler sounds like “um” are ignored.

errors.not-supported: This browser can’t recognise speech. Use Chrome, Edge or Safari — or download the offline Whisper engine in Settings.
errors.permission-denied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in the browser’s site settings and try again.

errors.language-not-supported: This browser can’t recognise this language.
errors.busy: The microphone is busy — try again in a moment.
errors.model-missing: The offline Whisper model isn’t downloaded yet — download it in Settings.
errors.unknown: Speech recognition stopped unexpectedly. Try again.
errors.iosStandalone: On iPhone, speech recognition can fail in the installed app. If it keeps failing, open Teleo in Safari or switch to offline Whisper in Settings.

privacy.title: Before you speak
privacy.body: Teleo never stores your voice and sends nothing to us. The speech recognition built into your browser may send audio to {{vendor}} to turn it into text.
privacy.bodyOnDevice: Teleo never stores your voice and sends nothing to us. Speech is recognised right on this device, so the audio never leaves it.
privacy.onDevice: Good news: your browser can recognise this language on the device.
privacy.whisper: Prefer fully private recognition? Switch to offline Whisper in Settings — the audio then never leaves your device.
